elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason and requires Contractor, at Company's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: Clause (i) expressly provides transition assistance for up to six (6) months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Clause (i) expressly states that assistance will be provided at Contractor's then-current rates.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Clause (ii) requires Contractor to return to Company all Confidential Information and other Company data and materials in Contractor's possession.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (ii) requires return within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Clause (ii) expressly requires return in a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: After return, Vendor must delete Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) requires Contractor thereafter to delete the Company data and materials from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after deletion.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) requires Contractor to certify the deletion to Company in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph requires Contractor, at Company's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance upon expiry or termination.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: The required availability for up to six (6) months encompasses the fallback period of ninety (90) days.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Clause (ii) requires Contractor to return Company data to Company in a standard machine-readable format, satisfying the data-export requirement.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (ii) expressly requires the return within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. It is not minimal because it expands the return-and-deletion obligation beyond Customer Data to Works, Confidential Information, and other Company materials. It otherwise preserves the existing termination and payment terms without contradiction. Drafting quality is reduced because requiring all Works and materials to be returned in a machine-readable format may be impractical, and deletion is limited to Contractor's systems without addressing other copies or repositories.
